zeroSwingBoundary.interpretation: Finite-swing standing bounding orbits approach an all-stance contact itinerary. Exact coincident touchdown/liftoff is excluded from the saved results because the native timing convention would select no contact rather than the limiting full stance.

coverageInfo.statement: Both directions of the finite-swing standing bounding family were continued through folds. One side approaches a full-stance contact-itinerary boundary; the high-compression side remains globally unresolved and is truncated conservatively by independent replay precision. The entire mathematical branch is not established.
coverageInfo.deliveredEndpointReason: Last contiguous point passing the unchanged native residual/mean/half-cycle gates AND independent full-period replays at ODE tolerances1e-13 and3e-14.
coverageInfo.tighterReplayTailStatus: Raw native-passing tail retained in continuation artifacts, excluded from the deliverable because tighter full-period replays exceed1e-8.

sourceInfo.name: Standing bounding parent connected to drifting BIP
sourceInfo.sectionDefinition: Stored turning section fixes dy0=phi0=0. The verified BIP critical orbit is at a height minimum; section orientation may change along the family. It is not generally a descending-apex section.
sourceInfo.standingDefinition: Cycle-average horizontal velocity is zero. Instantaneous horizontal velocity, pitch rate and leg angular rates generally are not zero.
sourceInfo.GRFMetricDefinition: minimumAxialGRF is the minimum per-leg axial spring force (native GRFs columns1:4). It is not the vertical GRF (columns9:12). Negative values represent axial tension.
